author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Syncro RMM alerts. The bridge in bridges/syncro-rmm-alerts pulls them from GET /api/v1/rmm_alerts and posts each one unchanged to HTTP Ingest. Every alert goes to the third-party alert schema.
notes:
Setup:
- Syncro has no syslog export, and its notification set webhook doesn't document a payload.
- bridges/syncro-rmm-alerts pulls RMM alerts from GET /api/v1/rmm_alerts and posts each one unchanged to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration.

Field mapping:
- Every alert goes to the third-party alert schema with the device, description, output, trigger, ticket and resolved state.
- Syncro gives no severity, so none is set.

Sources and licenses:
- Fields follow the RmmAlert example in Syncro's public API spec, which leaves properties empty.

Made up in the samples:
- The names inside properties (trigger, event_id) and all values in the samples are made up.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (56 of 56 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- The bridge picks up new alerts; a later change to an alert, such as resolving it, isn't sent again.
- Syncro's API has no account audit log, so technician logins and script runs aren't covered.
